description: Empties the whole Cloudflare cache for this site. Use it when the owner has asked and visitors are seeing something stale that a normal content save did not clear; saving a post already clears its own pages. ⚠️ Until the cache rebuilds, every visitor reaches the server directly, so the site may be slower. Tell the owner before you do this. Limited to 2 purges an hour for the whole site, across all connections. A site without Cloudflare connected is refused.
name: agentimus-purge-edge-cache

zone.description: The Cloudflare zone that was purged.

title: Empty this site’s Cloudflare cache
